projectDescription: A CLI tool (and HTTP service) that automatically generates CiliumNetworkPolicy YAML files from Hubble flow JSON data captured in Kubernetes clusters.
keyFeatures: Automatic CiliumNetworkPolicy generation from Hubble flow JSON files
Smart label filtering with priority and fallback label selection
Cross-namespace traffic support with automatic namespace label injection
FQDN egress rules with required DNS resolution rules for external traffic
CIDR-based egress rules for world traffic without resolvable FQDNs
Reserved entity support (kube-apiserver, host, remote-node, world)
Flow aggregation: multiple flows with the same source/destination merged into a single policy
HTTP server mode with a built-in Web UI and Grafana integration
YOLO mode for permissive development/testing policies
